name: morning-digest
description: Summarize deferred P3 memory warnings and 24-hour node stability metrics at 07:00 local time (skipping P3 quiet-hour noise from 23:00-07:00).
prompt: Call @franken-sentinel/incident_list and @franken-sentinel/node_snapshot to collect P3 incidents and 24-hour PSI/memory summary per node. Send one concise redacted digest (<= 700 chars) via @franken-wa/wa_notify with severity='P3'.
